messages:
jen: Heads-up — HelixBio ticket: customer says models disappeared from Console (UI shows empty model list) but inference via API tokens still works. They reported this right after we applied the new KMS tag cleanup job earlier tonight. Can someone triage?

priya: on it. can you paste any console logs or error snippets from the customer's session?

jen: pasted from their browser console + our proxy logs:
```
ERROR GET /v1/models/list 403 AccessDenied
platform-proxy: downstream call to kms:DescribeKey failed: AccessDenied
trace: request_id=0a1b2c3d
```
Also our service logs show: `kms:DescribeKey denied for arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd-efgh` when Console tries to enumerate encrypted model metadata.

alex.k: quick hypothesis — the KMS tagging cleanup changed the key tag from `environment=prod` to `env=production` (we consolidated tags). We have a couple of policy conditions that grant DescribeKey only when `kms:ResourceTags/environment = prod` for the PlatformRole. If tags changed, DescribeKey will be denied which would block listing model metadata in Console but API tokens that target specific key ARN might still succeed.

micah: confirmed in the audit — tag change push at 2025-10-12T02:14Z by infra/cleanup-job. Key had tags: `{ "environment": "prod" }` -> `{ "env": "production" }`.

priya: ok, so customer isn't actually revoked for calling models via API, they just can't enumerate. We should do two things: (1) quick mitigation for HelixBio, (2) longer-term fix to avoid fragile tag-based conditions.

micah: mitigation = re-add previous tag on affected keys. Doing now.

ops-bot: deploy-job/infra-kms-tag-cleanup reverted tag changes on 3 keys (key-id abcd-efgh, key-id bcde-fghi, key-id cdef-ghij). Rollback started at 2025-10-12T02:22Z.

alex.k: while rollback runs, we should also update the policy to avoid denying DescribeKey for platform console role on tag mismatch. Proposed minimal change to KMS key policy condition: replace `kms:ResourceTags/environment` condition with an explicit principal-based allow for PlatformRole DescribeKey. Example snippet:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123:role/PlatformRole"},
  "Action": "kms:DescribeKey",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/managed-by": "redwood-infra"}
  }
}
```
This keeps some tag hygiene but doesn't rely on the `environment` tag.

priya: agree. I'll open a security review PR and include the audit logs + customer impact. @sarah can you approve the emergency PR?

sarah: saw the thread. I'll review the PR now and fast-track. Also want a follow-up to add unit tests for tag normalization and a post-deploy check that enumerates keys from Console role.

micah: rollback finished at 2025-10-12T02:25Z. HelixBio reports models visible again in Console.

jen: customer confirmed via support: "models are back, thanks" :tada: I sent a summary and apology and noted we're doing a policy fix.

ops-bot: incident-note created: INC-2025-102-02 kms-tag-policy-caused-console-enumeration-gap. Assigned to eng-security.

priya: filing follow-ups: (1) PR to update key policy to include principal allow (2) add integration test that simulates tag-norm mismatch (3) add monitoring alert when Console DescribeKey starts getting AccessDenied spikes.

alex.k: adding also an asap runbook step to check for tag renames after infra cleanup jobs — ensure incompatible tag aliases are mapped.

jen: thanks everyone. closing thread once PR merged and customer confirmed final note.

sarah: PR approved and merged 2025-10-12T03:10Z. Reopening in case we need to follow up, otherwise I'll mark as resolved tomorrow after post-deploy checks pass.

jen: resolved from customer side. Marking thread closed for now. :white_check_mark:
